whoWeAre.badge: WHO WE ARE • VISIONTECH ENGINEERING LTD.
whoWeAre.headline: Who We Are
whoWeAre.callout: VEL is working as EPC contractor in power sector & Industrial area.
whoWeAre.para1: Since 2023, VisionTech Engineering Ltd. began its journey with a strong foundation of extensive professional experience in engineering, power, infrastructure and project implementation. Over the years, the company has evolved into a trusted EPC contractor, expanding its capabilities across Civil, Electro-Mechanical, Power & Energy, Infrastructure, Structural Steel, MEP and Industrial services.
whoWeAre.para2: Through successful project execution, strategic partnerships and a commitment to quality, innovation, safety and client satisfaction, VisionTech has steadily strengthened its position in Bangladesh’s engineering and construction sector.
whoWeAre.para3: Today, VisionTech continues to grow with a clear vision of becoming a leading engineering and construction company, contributing to the sustainable development of Bangladesh.

ourServices.heroDesc: Integrated turnkey EPC delivery, sovereign equipment supply & trading, and multimodal heavy lift transport across Bangladesh's power, energy, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.

energyPower.title: 400kV, 230kV & 132kV Turnkey GIS Substations & Transmission
energyPower.desc: VisionTech delivers apex turnkey GIS and AIS substation construction across Bangladesh with sovereign utilities including PGCB, DPDC, and BREB. Proven benchmarks include Bhulta 400/230/132kV GIS, Purbasadipur 230/132kV, Madunaghat 230kV Upgradation, Feni 230/132kV, and Maijdee 132/33kV. In underground transmission, VEL manufactured and installed 100,000+ certified concrete cable protection slabs (DPDC Signboard to Siddhirganj, BDT 18.3M).

industrialManufacturing.title: Heavy Factory Civil, PEB Structures & Industrial MEP Systems
industrialManufacturing.desc: Complete engineering design and site construction for industrial processing complexes, textile mills, and corporate infrastructure. Key credentials include Onin Textile Mills perimeter security & heavy MEP drainage works (BDT 12.6M), PTC PLC (Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation subsidiary) corporate headquarters renovation, and deep equipment foundation pads engineered for dynamic machinery vibration absorption.
industrialManufacturing.feature1Desc: Long-span structural steel factory bays & warehouses
industrialManufacturing.feature2Desc: High-capacity busbar trunking, HVAC & fire safety loops

renewableEnergy.title: Utility Solar PV Parks, Industrial Rooftops & Grid Tie-in EPC
renewableEnergy.desc: Accelerating Bangladesh's clean energy transition through turnkey solar photovoltaic (PV) generation systems. VisionTech integrates ground-mounted solar arrays, industrial net-metered rooftop solar installations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and specialized step-up substations connecting renewable megawatts smoothly to the national grid.
renewableEnergy.feature1Desc: Tier-1 PV modules, string/central inverters & mounting
renewableEnergy.feature2Desc: Harmonic filtering, metering & sovereign grid tie-in

infrastructureTransportation.title: Highway Bridges, Viaducts, Deep Piling & Transport Links
infrastructureTransportation.desc: Execution of mission-critical civil infrastructure that drives national mobility. Our record includes auxiliary civil works on the landmark Kanchpur-Meghna-Gumti 2nd Bridges (Package PW-01), heavy foundation piling, RC box culverts, bridge approach ramps, and deep drainage civil networks built to withstand severe subtropical hydrological conditions.
infrastructureTransportation.feature1Desc: Approaches, retaining walls, slope protection & spans
infrastructureTransportation.feature2Desc: Port corridors, container yards & terminal aprons

supplyTrading.title: Power Grid Equipment, Switchgear & High-Voltage Consumables
supplyTrading.desc: VisionTech provides authorized international procurement and sovereign trading for primary substation assets. From high-capacity power transformers, 132kV/33kV GIS/AIS switchgear panels, CT/PT instrument transformers, and lightning arresters to precast cable protection slabs and certified capital spares.

transportHandling.title: Multimodal Heavy Lift Transport, Jacking & Plinth Placement
transportHandling.desc: Specialized logistical execution for oversized, super-heavy power plant transformers, turbines, and industrial machinery through sister concern Swadesh Carrying. Services include seaport offloading, riverine barge towing, hydraulic multi-axle overland haulage, civil plinth positioning, dragging, and precision optical alignment.

completed.title: 132/33 kV Underground Cable Protection Slab Works
completed.scope: Strengthening of Power System Network under DPDC area. Manufacture, supply, transportation and interlocking installation of reinforced concrete protective slabs for 132/33 kV underground transmission (Signboard to Siddhirganj).

completed.title: Corporate Office Building Renovation & Modernization
completed.scope: Full-scope turnkey EPC civil works, sanitary systems, modern electrical infrastructure, AC installation, glass partitioning, reception architecture, and CCTV surveillance networks.

completed.title: Moulovibazar PBS 100% Rural Electrification Land Development
completed.scope: Distribution Network Expansion at 100% Rural Electrification DNE (DMCS) Moulovibazar-6. Land development with high-density soil compaction, precision leveling, dressing, and civil foundation preparation.

completed.title: Bhulta 400/230/132kV Turnkey GIS Substation Civil Works
completed.scope: Complete civil execution of 400kV & 230kV GIS Control Room Buildings, heavy transformer foundations, cable trenches, internal roads, and switchyard graveling for PGCB's apex national grid hub.

completed.title: Purbasadipur 230/132kV & 132/33kV GIS Substation
completed.scope: Full civil scope including 230kV & 132kV GIS control buildings, transformer foundations, piling works, cable trenches, internal roads, and switchyard finishing.

completed.title: Bheramara 360MW Combined Cycle Power Plant Civil Works
completed.scope: Complete civil infrastructure works, heavy equipment foundations, pump houses, cable trenches, and auxiliary power generation structures for national base-load power.

running.title: New Bibiyana 230/132/33kV GIS Substation Land Development
running.scope: Power Grid Network Strengthening Project under PGCB. Turnkey land development, deep compaction, site leveling & grading, sub-base preparation, and switchyard formation for 230/132/33kV GIS Substation.

running.title: Kaliganj 132/33 KV AIS Substation Graveling & Yard Works
running.scope: Power Grid Network Strengthening Project under PGCB. Supply and precision laying of switchyard graveling work, drainage conduits, and civil auxiliary works for Kaliganj 132/33 KV AIS Substation.

running.title: 132/33kV Transmission Cable Protection Slab Installation
running.scope: Continuous high-volume precision casting, certified quality testing, multi-ton transport, and sequential interlocking installation of protective concrete slabs along active underground transmission lines.

sisterConcern.name: Swadesh Carrying Agency
sisterConcern.subtitle: Heavy Haulage, Specialized Hydraulic Multi-Axle Fleet & Inland Riverine Barge Logistics
sisterConcern.desc: Operating as VisionTech's integrated logistics backbone, Swadesh Carrying commands specialized multi-axle modular trailers, heavy-lift tug-barges, and precision jacking-skidding systems. Swadesh guarantees zero-damage overland and inland riverine haulage of 400kV transformers, turbines, and oversized industrial capital assets from Chattogram and Mongla seaports to remote substation sites nationwide.
